parent_discovery_protocol.note: RF-04's registered discovery protocol already names 32-64 trials/cutoff and the 2021-01-01..2023-12-31 development window; FUP-02 is the execution of that registration, not a new trial budget

run_gate: run_fup02.py refuses to execute any shard unless this artifact exists and its status is REGISTERED_BEFORE_THE_FUP02_RUNS; --register-budget writes it once

scope.route: event (all 20 cells; FUP-01 qualified A-VWAP/A-HASH, A-SC/A-HMA already qualified)
scope.shard_granularity: cell x arm, checkpointed per fold/cutoff

trial_budget.selection_reason: the low end of the registered 32-64 range is executed so the fixed invocation budget closes the most complete paired cells; the per-arm compute is identical and no arm is granted more trials than the other

seed_policy.derivation: the installed engine derives the per-fold seed as (seed + fold_id * 1000003) mod 2**32; both arms and every cell use the same base seed and the same derivation

coverage_review_rule.when: before any final design freeze; not executed by FUP-02 itself
coverage_review_rule.admissible_definition: a scored cutoff is admissible when the selector returned selected parameters and at least one trial objective is finite; pruned/infeasible-only cutoffs are not admissible
coverage_review_rule.escalation: if admissible_over_scored < 0.80 or (nonfinite + infeasible) / trials > 0.25, escalate the trial budget to 64 in a REVISED budget revision before the frozen rerun; if coverage stays insufficient, record the insufficiency and do not present the run as a fully supported design freeze
coverage_review_rule.deep_selector_audit: the public provider payload does not expose selector/cluster/fallback fields; the RF-04.2 transparency ledger deep audit remains the tool for that question

resource_caps.worker_justification: the registered sandbox resource budget is workers=1; keeping one worker keeps wall seconds comparable with RF-04.6 and keeps both arms sequential inside a cell (a shard is a cell x arm boundary, never a per-arm race)
resource_caps.cpu_change: none requested; the registered sandbox cpu_limit=2 is unchanged
resource_caps.total_wall_budget_note: approved upper bound across all resumable invocations; every invocation writes its own elapsed seconds and stop reason, and unused budget is never silently transferred to one arm

may_change: the trial budget inside the registered 32-64 range when the coverage review requires it
must_not_change: per-arm compute: both arms always receive the same trial budget, seed, training memory, economics and route
a completed shard is never recomputed for a budget revision
a budget increase is never applied to one arm only
revision_rule.cpu_change_rule: any worker/CPU change needs a measured justification recorded here before the affected shards run and applies to both arms; no CPU change is requested by this revision

non_fabrication: a non-run or stopped shard/fold stores null metrics plus the exact reason; nothing is zero-filled or estimated
benchmark_conditions: lab venv, one worker, thread-pinned, fold 0 of the registered calendar schedule, real snapshot partitions; measured immediately before registration, no selection on these numbers beyond choosing the cheapest-first execution order

contamination.reason: 2021-2023 was already exposed to design and repair work in RF-01..RF-05; FUP-02 adds trials and the 2023 development year but is not a holdout and makes no confirmation claim
